description.text: Notes： The first year courses include Chinese language training and basic medical courses, tuition fee is 12,000 RMB/ year/person; From the 2nd to 6th year start to learn medical courses, tuition fee is20,000 RMB/year/person. Why Guilin Medical University 1) Located in the world famous scenic city of Guilin 2) Excellent studying and living environment 3)Highly qualified, internationally experienced staff devoted to serving the university 4) Reasonable tuition fee and low living cost 5) Focus on the quality of teaching and learning outcomes 6) Convenient transportation connections to East and Southeast Asia Duration 6 years Fee Tuition Fee: Chinese training + basic medical courses (1st year) 12,000 RMB/year/person Medical courses study (from 2nd to 6th year) 20,000 RMB/year/person Accommodation Fee: Double room: 3500 RMB per person per year Certificate of Graduation and Degree Qualified students will be granted certificates of graduation and Bachelor's Degree ofClinical Medicine(MBBS) by Guilin Medical University

duration.text: The Clinical Medicine at Guilin Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. 4 Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Physical Examination Record for Foreigners 6. Application form

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport in good health 2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
